about: Hand decisions about MLA2 stat blocks that scripts/msh/roster.py applies after parsing (scripts/msh/gridbooks.py reads this book). The misprints and the printed Karma of None and 0 were read off the page images (survey apps/marvel-heroes/docs/surveys/mla2.md, the misprints tables of Stat blocks; decisions 4, 5 and 6); none is a guess from OCR.
Facts only - numbers, rank codes and a few words of a label - so this file is committed while roster.json stays in the local cache.
match     {page, header, codes}: the printed page in the Adventure Book, the start of the entry's header, and where one card holds two blocks the block's seven codes as read
verdict   misprint    the book prints a value its own arithmetic contradicts; 'printed' keeps what the page says, 'corrected' what the rules give
as_printed  the page is unambiguous and the check still fails; kept as printed, and the note says why
label       the name of a second block on a card (decision 4)

text        match {row}: an msh_book_text row key. 'read' is a fragment of a few words as the OCR gives it after folding to ASCII, 'printed' the same fragment as the page prints it. It must occur once in the row, or npcs.py stops.
also      further values of the same block, each {verdict, field, printed, and corrected for a misprint}: one override matches one block, and a block can print more than one thing to explain
checked   the date the page image was read

The mechanical mummy's R prints RP (4) (printed 41): no override, since the number is right and only the spelling is not; RP is a rank_aliases entry for Poor (decision 5), read through the registry's code_rank_aliases.

overrides.note: Printed P AM 75 (printed 4): 75 is Monstrous's number, outside Amazing's range (46-62), and Karma 125 = 10 + 40 + 75 holds on the 75, so the code is the misprint; MLA1's card for him prints MN 75. Survey decision 5.
Printed Health 70 (printed 36): F and A EX 20, S and E RM 30, each code agreeing with its number, sum to 100, and the Karma 18 holds. Survey decision 5.

Printed E EX 30 (printed 40, the clown of exhibit 4): 30 is Remarkable's number, outside Excellent's range (16-25), and the Health 80 = 10 + 30 + 10 + 30 holds on the 30, so the code is the misprint (decision 5). Its Karma prints 0, a robot, as the other House of Madness grids (decision 6). The crop reads the E as EX 80; the registry's mend_by_health reads it 30.

Printed Health 200 (printed 62): F UN 100, A EX 20, S and E MN 75, each code agreeing with its number, sum to 270, and the Karma 50 holds. The codes match his own block, not Eric Masterson's on the same card. Survey decision 5.
